source: Create game here players can be working in a office and name the office as 'officiial rolox hq' make it a real life office experience

image_prompt.text: The main open-plan floor of the office as the gathering core, sized so a full server of players can mill around without jamming
The reception area and its signage reading 'officiial rolox hq', the thing you see and orient by on arrival
Composed corners of the office worth standing in for a screenshot - a window view, a meeting room, a break spot
The office itself is the enterable interior - the workspace, meeting rooms and break areas players go inside and move between

notes: Every shape in this genre is a settlement, a wilderness or a runway; this build is one interior, so static settlement was forced and the interior carried on building-interior instead, which is what puts it on P3.
'real life office experience' is read as a realism instruction rather than a theme keyword.
The office name is misspelled in the prompt and has been kept verbatim.

open_questions.ask: What does 'working' actually involve - assigned desk jobs and tasks, or free roleplay in an office setting?
One floor, or a whole building with lifts between floors?

coverage_missing.ask: Are there actual jobs and tasks to do, or is it open roleplay?
A single floor or a multi-floor building?
Is the outside of the building part of the map, or does play start indoors?
Is this meant to look like the actual Roblox headquarters, or a generic modern office?

answers.ask: What does 'working' actually involve - assigned desk jobs and tasks, or free roleplay in an office setting?
answers.answer: Use free roleplay in an office setting; players can work at desks and use the office spaces as part of the real-life office experience.

answers.ask: One floor, or a whole building with lifts between floors?
answers.answer: Make it one office floor to keep the experience focused and plainly playable.
